The other day, an African American person and a Roma person were in the store at the same time shopping when the police arrived. The African American customer had clothing they hadn't paid for from the store in their bag while the Roma customer had nothing in their bag but an orange and a notebook. Who didn't steal the clothing?
A. Cannot be determined
B. The Roma person
C. The African American person
